thread:
Sam: Heads-up: PR #4922 contains updated SDK snippets for the batching API and migration notes. We need a docs review + merge before docs freeze (Thu 11:59pm PT). Preview currently shows a failing snippet test.

Priya: I can pick it up. Is this going into versioned docs (v0.9) and unversioned?

Sam: Yes, both. Add frontmatter `version: v0.9` and a short migration note in the top-level banner. Also note it's behind the FF `batching.smart_policy` so we should mark it as gated.

Omar: What does the snippet test fail show? I saw `NameError` complaining about `BatchClient` in the Python example.

Maya: Looks like the example imports `from redwood import BatchClient` but the SDK renamed it to `BatchingClient` in 1.11.0. Quick fix: change class name and update usage to `with BatchingClient() as client:`.

Priya: I'll update the snippet and run the snippet harness locally. Also will add an inline comment showing the version compatibility: `# SDK >= 1.11.0`.

docs-ci-bot: Note: after pushing, rerun CI with `gh workflow run docs-preview.yml -f pr=4922` or use Actions. Snippet harness sometimes times out on first run.

Sam: Release-captain, can you confirm target merge time? We want this merged early enough for QA to validate redirects (6pm PT Thu preferred).

release-captain: Confirmed: target merge by 6pm PT Thu to get into v0.9.2 RC. Any CI flakiness escalated by 5pm will be considered for manual hold.

Priya: Patch pushed: renamed to `BatchingClient`, added `# SDK >= 1.11.0`, updated frontmatter `version: v0.9`, and added gated note about `batching.smart_policy`.

docs-ci-bot: Preview job queued for PR 4922. Link-check passed; snippet harness running...

Omar: Quick ask: can we keep the old `client.batch_send()` example as a legacy note? Some customers still on 1.10.x. Maybe add a small compatibility section.

Priya: Good call. I added a "Compatibility (pre-1.11)" box with the old call and a migration pointer.

docs-ci-bot: Snippet harness failed on first run (timeout). Manual rerun recommended. Use `gh workflow run docs-preview.yml -f pr=4922` or click Re-run in Actions.

Maya: I kicked a manual rerun.

docs-ci-bot: Second run succeeded. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/4922. All checks green.

Sam: Priya, please paste the preview URL in the PR description so QA picks it up automatically.

Priya: Done. PR description updated with preview link and a 1-line changelog under Migration notes.

QA-bot: QA harness detected new preview for PR 4922. Scheduling smoke tests. Estimated runtime ~20m.

Omar: Content review pass done. Approved.

Priya: Thanks Omar. Omar + Maya, can one of you add an approve so I can merge after the smoke tests?

Maya: Approved.

QA-bot: Smoke tests passed.
